race.comment: ZAMPANO (8) tackled a similar race to this at Tamworth last start where he worked home well to finish third although never looking a chance. Rock-hard fit after three runs back from a spell and gets every chance with the help of the inside alley. Ready to return to winning ways. PRINCE OF SEPANG (10) ran his best race for a while last time out at Coonamble, closing in good style to be beaten just 1.5 lengths in a 1200m open sprint. Twice a winner at this trip so with the light weight he comes right into contention. WARRIOR FOR PEACE (3) is back after a brief spell. Placed over 1300m at Randwick to kick off the last campaign. Will find this short of his best but should be storming home. HELLCIBELL (6) was beaten narrowly in open company at Muswellbrook recently. Yet to miss the frame in six runs at Scone. A must for trifectas and first fours. ENTERPRISE LEGEND (7) has struggled a little of late but drops in grade today and can improve.
